title: Nonnegativity of total variation distance
statement: Let $\mu$ and $\nu$ be probability measures on a measurable space $\Omega$. Then their total variation distance is nonnegative, $\mathrm{TV}(\mu,\nu) \ge 0$.
hypotheses_covered: μ and ν are probability measures on a measurable space Ω
replaced: For any two probability measures $\mu$ and $\nu$, $\mathrm{TV}(\mu,\nu) \ge 0$.
